semantics.connection_type: Explicit access classification only; absent when unknown. Overlay tunnels do not identify subscriber access technology.
semantics.location: Operator-authorized GeoFeed claim; registry registration country is separate.
semantics.network_types: Published service roles or observed BGP path characteristics; method and source describe the evidence.
semantics.ptr: Reverse DNS observations apply only to their queried host address.
semantics.roa_status: Registry-derived DN42 origin policy; method and origin ASN are attached to each observation. No cryptographic RPKI validation is implied.
